title: Observe cache requests, entries, evictions and estimated size
goal: Collect built-in in-process cache metrics and statistics while keeping estimated size in consistent application-defined units.

selectionNotes: Enable TrackStatistics and register AddMetrics for the DI meter factory.
Estimated size is application accounting, not bytes or process memory; SizeLimit and every entry Size must use the same unit.
Explicit Remove/Clear are excluded from the pinned eviction count; the verified workload uses compaction.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The newer comparison uses .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; the exact RC2 SDK is a verification baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode; no preview language syntax is used.

platforms: Desktop/server .NET 11 with Microsoft.AspNetCore.App; executed on Windows x64. Browser/WASI/mobile excluded.
prerequisites: Console project: TargetFramework=net11.0, LangVersion=15.0, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable, FrameworkReference Microsoft.AspNetCore.App. Exact imports and registration steps are in the body.
constraints: Enable TrackStatistics and register AddMetrics for the DI meter factory.
Estimated size is application accounting, not bytes or process memory; SizeLimit and every entry Size must use the same unit.
Explicit Remove/Clear are excluded from the pinned eviction count; the verified workload uses compaction.
No external account, provisioning, rendering integration, optional workload or unverified older-target package route is required or advertised.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation pending. No experimental API opt-in.

evidence.scope: Real statistics/custom metric and value-derived HybridCache SetAsync/local expiry; no distributed backend.
Real built-in cache statistics/four metrics and value-derived Hybrid local expiry; LocalSize remains a known requested-24/observed-12 RC gap accepted by Pingu for GA-targeted PR delivery.

humanProof.scope: Managed in-process claims need no Human-only proof. External services, distributed backends, browser/native behavior and GA reconciliation are not claimed. The LocalSize RC gap is explicit where applicable.
